caption: The drawing presents a detailed illustration of a green plaid dress with short sleeves and a full skirt, occupying the central portion of the image. The bodice is fitted with a gathered waistband, and the skirt is flared with gentle pleats. The sleeves are short, puffed, and finished with a double band detail, and the neckline is rounded. A thin, vertical pocket is visible on the right side of the dress. To the upper right and upper left of the main dress, there are two secondary garment sketches in pencil: one on the right shows the rear view of the same dress with similar sleeve and neckline details, and one on the left depicts a matching short cape or jacket in green plaid with a blue lining, draped over an outline of the dress. The background is a light cream color, and the overall composition centers the colored dress with the two pencil-drawn garment elements on either side at the top.
title: Child's Dress and Cape
